audit_scope: Independent read-only audit of Qwen heldout32 exact_v2 and rht_v2_postrms results.
caveats: All recomputations were performed read-only against the canonical RunPod workspace after verifying local mirror hashes for the manifest, both panel files, both summaries, both pack audits, both unpack audits, and sampled decode JSONs.

The independent MSE audit uses the decoded JSON aggregation fields fp16_sse_sum_fp64 and source_energy_sum_fp64, which reproduce the published summary aggregates exactly to <1e-15 but do not re-decode raw payload bits from scratch.
Exact and RHT use the same decoder, decoder map, packer, and unpacker hashes; only the encoder hash and reservoir payload contents differ between variants.

encoder_claim_boundary_unique: published D=0.20 Tal-Vardy reliability order with ideal entropy length; not yet a normative arithmetic bitstream

rht.claim_boundary: POLARIS-SC-v2 plus a deterministic zero-side-bit RHT adapter; a same-manifest exact run is required for comparative attribution.

encoder_claim_boundary_unique: published D=0.20 Tal-Vardy reliability order with ideal entropy length; not yet a normative arithmetic bitstream

unique_sign_rule: +1 iff splitmix64(seed_u64 + i) low bit is zero; else -1
